_notes: Taito do Brasil 1979 hardware (PinMAME machine taito_old): 8080 CPU, five 1KB ROMs, and the 256-byte
battery-backed window at 0x1000 that the driver saves as the .nv file. Same design as the later boards one page
lower: display DMA at 0x1000, command DMA at 0x1010, settings at 0x10F0, high score at 0x10F9, credits at 0x10FF.
